title: Resume your online application or registration – Births, Deaths and Marriages
summary: This page explains how to save and resume online applications for Births, Deaths, and Marriages.
intro: You're able to save and resume the following online Births, Deaths and Marriages applications:
what_you_need: The email address you entered on your application form.
The online reference number (ORN) provided during your application.

how_to_steps.text: Go to the section Resume an application or registration on the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages website.
Select the relevant certificate option (for example, birth certificate).
Enter your email address and ORN to resume.

contact: If you have problems with your application contact Service NSW.

internal_links.text: Replace a change of name certificate
Apply to register a relationship in NSW

faqs.q: What applications can I resume online?
faqs.a: You can resume online applications for Births, Deaths, and Marriages.

faqs.q: What do I need to resume my application?
faqs.a: You need the email address used on the application and the online reference number (ORN) provided when you applied.

faqs.q: Where do I go to resume my application?
faqs.a: Go to the 'Resume an application or registration' section on the Registry of Births, Deaths and Marriages website.
